items.title: Hedera Ambassador Program
items.claim: Hedera’s current official page visibly links an application route and describes roles and non-cash benefits.

items.title: Cyfrin Ambassadors
items.claim: Cyfrin’s official page invites applications, says it reviews them and describes work, certification and non-cash benefits.

items.title: Nexo Crypto Ambassador Program
items.claim: The previously tracked Nexo ambassador URL now redirects to Nexo’s general UK site and did not expose an ambassador application or current terms.

items.title: Aster Ambassador Program
items.claim: Aster’s official announcement says applications are open year-round and gives work, review, event-support and no-salary terms.

items.title: Elk Ambassador Program
items.claim: Elk’s official page links an application and states that the selected apprentice works as a volunteer during a trial.

items.title: Nomis Ambassador Program
items.claim: Nomis documentation links a sign-up form and states referral-linked fee rewards and contributor tasks.

items.title: Bitget Trading Builder recruitment
items.claim: Bitget’s official article sets a 30 Sep 2026 recruitment deadline, criteria, work and shared-pool conditions.

items.title: Soneium Ambassador Program
items.claim: Soneium’s official announcement explicitly says it is opening the Ambassador Program and links an “Apply now” Typeform, while the hosted form did not expose its current submission state.

items.title: Solana University Ambassador Program
items.claim: Solana’s page still renders fields while its published 1 Sep close date has passed.

items.title: PIVX Ambassador Program
items.claim: PIVX’s official page says positions are referral-only.

items.title: SideShift Ambassador Program
items.claim: SideShift’s current official page says applications are currently closed while retaining program reward terms.

items.title: FTC: What to know about cryptocurrency scams
items.claim: FTC guidance says a purported crypto job requiring an advance crypto payment is a scam.

items.title: FBI: Work-from-home scams
items.claim: FBI guidance warns of task scams that require crypto deposits to unlock work.

items.title: MetaMask Ambassador Program guide
items.claim: MetaMask’s official forum says ambassador participation is voluntary and unpaid, with resources and support depending on contribution.

items.title: MetaMask application discussion
items.claim: The application discussion records a staff reply on 4 Jun 2026 that the form was currently closed; no later reopening notice was found in the official forum pages inspected.

items.title: Torium Ambassador Program
items.claim: Torium’s issuer-operated ambassador page labels applications open and states a manual review, a seven-day public-content track and conditional USDT and TOR reward rules.

items.title: Torium Ambassador Program Terms
items.claim: Torium’s July 2026 terms require an account and social-account information, state that rewards may be denied or reversed, and describe payout information and disclosure duties.
